description: Turkish glossary of the game's own text (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). terms: English term of glossary_en.json -> the Turkish form used in every file. keep_latin: not needed (Latin script). fallback_glyphs: letters the game font has no glyph for; the engine draws them from the system font and the tools measure them as their base letter. style: the rules of voice and form.

style.address: Harry and Cybil: sen, both ways. Harry and Lisa: sen. Harry and Kaufmann: siz, both ways, in the hospital and the bar; Kaufmann drops to sen when he loses his temper in the motel, Harry keeps siz. Dahlia to everyone: sen, elevated and solemn (kudret, gazap, yazgı, vakit); Harry to Dahlia: siz until the amusement park, sen from there on. Dahlia and Kaufmann: sen. Alessa to Dahlia: anne, anneciğim; Dahlia of herself: annen. Cheryl to Harry: baba. The UFO ending addresses the aliens in the plural (siz).
style.gender: Turkish has no grammatical gender: no line depends on the speaker's sex.
style.quotes: “ ” for the [ ] of the English; the dash is the character — (U+2014), which the English writes as '='.
style.item_in_sentence: an item name inside a sentence keeps its inventory spelling and takes no case suffix: 'Burada <name> var. Alınsın mı?', '<name> kullanıldı.', '<name> alındı.'
style.prompts: yes/no prompts are impersonal passives (Alınsın mı? Düğmeye basılsın mı? Açılsın mı?) so that Evet/Hayır answers them.
style.letters: the circumflex is written where the standard spelling keeps it (hâlâ, kâbus, hâl, dinî, âlem). Upper case follows Turkish casing: i -> İ, ı -> I.
style.clock: times of the clock tower puzzle stay as digits with the suffix after an apostrophe (10:00'da, 12:00'de, 5:00'te).

terms.resort area: tatil bölgesi (the town as a resort: tatil beldesi)
